tpms.when: 2019–2024, set from the multi-information display between the gauges (no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park somewhere safe and turn the vehicle to ON.
Use the arrow buttons on the steering wheel to go to the settings on the display between the gauges, then open Vehicle Settings (press and hold OK on the larger displays).
Choose TPWS (shown as TPMS on some displays), then Set Pressure.
Press and hold OK until a message appears on the display and the tire pressure light blinks 3 times.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked.
